summary: Implemented Bilibili provider enrichment: share-text URL extraction, provider metadata persistence, proxied cover images, fetched danmaku refs, DASH fallback URLs, and frontend provider info UI.

Updated 番组表 row layout to source, title, current status, info, play, cancel play, delete. Added cancel-current playback by allowing JOUEI payload enmokuId:null and clearing the current Enmoku through the existing authoritative sync path.

Fixed feedback regressions: kept sparse 番组表 rows flat, changed timeline danmaku to clock-positioned animations with mode-specific durations, and made fetched danmaku appear at the current playback position without requiring a pause/play cycle.

Refined the feedback fix: switched 番组表 rows from flex-column items to normal block flow, removed negative CSS animation delays from timeline danmaku to avoid jumpy browser sampling, and extended fixed danmaku duration so cues do not disappear mid-screen.
Forced 番组表 items into compact 32px flex rows with fixed min/max height and title ellipsis, replacing the failed natural-height/block-flow attempts that still stretched rows in the browser.

Reworked 番组表 row internals into source badge, flexible title, and fixed right-side action group. Removed hidden placeholder cells and added a title fallback so non-current or malformed rows do not collapse to only the source badge.
